 26 October 2026 3 min read Investors who subscribed to the ₹1,450.00 crore Paras Healthcare IPO can expect the share allotment to be finalised on October 26, 2026. The allotment details can be accessed online through the NSE and BSE websites or via the IPO registrar, MUFG Intime India Private Limited. 
 Once the allotment is concluded, Paras Healthcare is scheduled to make its stock market debut on October 28, 2026, on both the NSE and BSE. 
 Procedure to Check Paras Healthcare IPO Allotment Status Online on NSE 
 Visit the NSE’s IPO allotment verification status page here . 
 Select “Equity & SME IPO Bid Details”. 
 In Select, choose “PARASHLTH” . 
 Enter your PAN No. and Application No. 
 Click “Submit”. 
 Procedure to Check Paras Healthcare IPO Allotment Status Online on BSE 
 Click here to visit the application status page.  
 Under Issue Type, select “Equity” . 
 In Issue Name, select “Paras Healthcare Limited” . 
 Enter your “Application No. or PAN No.” 
 Enter the given Captcha correctly. 
 Click “Submit”. 
 Procedure to Check Paras Healthcare IPO Allotment Status on MUFG Intime India (Registrar to the issue) 
 Visit MUFG Intime India’s IPO allotment status page here . 
 In the “Select company”, choose “Paras Healthcare Limited”. 
 Enter any of the following details: 
 PAN 
 App. No. 
 DP/Client ID 
 Account No/ IFSC 
 Click “Submit”.

 Utilisation of IPO Proceeds 
 The company intends to utilise the net proceeds from the fresh issue towards: 
 Prepayment or scheduled re-payment, in full or part, of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the company  
 Investment in its wholly owned Subsidiary, PMHPL (which also operates the company’s hospital in Srinagar), for repayment/prepayment of borrowings, in full or part, of PMHPL  
 General corporate purposes 
 About Paras Healthcare Limited 
 Incorporated in 1987, Paras Healthcare Limited is a healthcare provider operating eight hospitals with a combined capacity of 2,211 beds across North India, Bihar and Jharkhand, under the “Paras Health” brand. As of June 30, 2026, its network spanned five states and one union territory. 
 The company plans to add 300 beds in Gurugram by Fiscal 2027 and 500 beds in Ludhiana by Fiscal 2028, taking its total capacity to 3,011 beds by March 2028. Its key specialties include cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastro sciences, orthopaedics and renal sciences, which contributed 74.70% of revenue in Fiscal 2026. The company had 1,084 doctors and 1,937 nurses as of June 30, 2026.
